title: This Shrimp Snaps Hard Enough to Create Heat Like the Sun
description: The pistol shrimp snaps its claw so fast that it makes a bubble that briefly gets incredibly hot.

scenes.text: There is a shrimp with a claw that works like a weapon. It is called the pistol shrimp.
scenes.subject: shrimp
scenes.say: [curious] There is a shrimp with a claw that works like a WEAPON. It is called the pistol shrimp.

scenes.text: It snaps its claw shut so quickly that it shoots out a jet of water and creates a tiny bubble.
scenes.subject: shrimp
scenes.say: It snaps its claw shut so quickly that it shoots out a jet of water and creates a tiny bubble.

scenes.text: When that bubble collapses, the inside briefly reaches thousands of degrees, close to the temperature of the Sun's surface.
scenes.subject: bubbles
scenes.say: [gasps] When that bubble collapses, the inside briefly reaches THOUSANDS of degrees, close to the temperature of the Sun's surface.

scenes.text: The snap is also one of the loudest sounds in the ocean, and it can stun small fish nearby.
scenes.subject: shrimp
scenes.say: [shouts] The snap is also one of the LOUDEST sounds in the ocean, and it can stun small fish nearby.

scenes.text: Small shrimp, huge power. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: shrimp
scenes.say: [laughs] Small shrimp, huge power. Follow for more weird facts.
